## Current objective
Modernize legacy SQLAlchemy 2.0 usage, starting with models, then remove remaining deprecated session/query patterns. Invoice pagination was superseded by webhook troubleshooting; CI jobs now must use `ci-runner-arm64`.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`ci-runner-small` is superseded. Pagination defaults: `limit=20`, `offset=0`; schema `InvoicePage`. `ledgerly/models.py` now uses `DeclarativeBase`. Negative PDF amounts are rendered; skipping is limited to zero. `ruff format --check ledgerly/billing/pdf.py tests/test_invoice_pdf.py` has status unknown.

## Ruled-out approaches
Invoice index `(customer_id, created_at)` doubled ingest latency. Raw point/72 row-height logic caused incorrect pagination; use `_row_height()`.

## Plan and progress
Models migration is done. Inspect `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and `tests/conftest.py`; replace SQLAlchemy 1.x factories/`Query.get()`; run full tests and Ruff. Exact next command: `pytest -q`.

## Recent work
PDF negative-line, currency grouping, and 86-item pagination fixes passed 14 PDF tests and 83 billing tests; golden fixtures stayed byte-stable. Full baseline was 148 passed, 2 skipped. `models.py` was converted to `DeclarativeBase`; validation remains pending.
